name: Magnitude

modes.label: No standalone managed browser tariff
modes.note: Current product is local inference; former browser framework used third-party cloud browsers. Unspecified guest OS is not a selectable OS guarantee.

plans.name: Open source local software
plans.note: Own machine/compute required; NOT free managed hosting.

features.ip_note: Self-hosted open-source library; browsers run locally or on a third-party provider (e.g. Kernel), so egress depends on the host.

caveats: Storage, snapshot GiB-month and public IPv4 prices are not published in the reviewed sources; null is not free.

No guaranteed vCPU allocation published; browser-hour is not a verified 4-vCPU/8-GiB VM equivalent. The sizes card keeps unknown hardware null; do not coerce it to zero or auto-rank against resource-guaranteed VMs.
Browser RAM is not published unless a specific mode overrides it.
Domain now advertises local open-model inference for macOS/Linux/Windows, not agent VM rental. Historical browser docs are search-indexed but current docs hostname did not resolve in direct fetch.
Client OS support is not cloud OS availability. Excluded from automatic hourly comparison; retained as an adjacent card to avoid mistaking framework license for free infrastructure.

Browser-agent product appears discontinued (2026-09-29): the open-source magnitudedev/browser-agent repo (Apache-2.0, not archived) had its last commit 2026-02-08 and npm magnitude-core latest 0.3.1 (published 2026-02-08); its README still links the dead docs.magnitude.run. The company homepage and docs now cover only a local open-model inference engine (macOS/Windows/Linux, Apache 2.0, 'No token costs, API keys, subscriptions, or rate limits'). No hosted browser, VM or sandbox tariff exists.
